title: Band 9 esse: to‘liq tahlil
goal_uz: Dars oxirida 9 ballik essening har bir gapi qanday vazifa bajarishini tushuntirib bera olasiz, bitta da’voni sabab, mexanizm, misol va oqibat zanjiri bilan rivojlantirasiz, noaniq so‘zlarni aniq kollokatsiyalarga almashtirasiz va matningizni to‘rt bosqichli tekshiruv bilan xatosiz holga keltirasiz.

scenes.title: Band 9 esse
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we looked at scientific writing. Today we take apart a band nine essay sentence by sentence, and then rebuild the skills behind it.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum, xush kelibsiz! Oldingi darsda ilmiy maqola uslubini o‘rgandik: tuzilma, ehtiyotkor da’vo va to‘g‘ri havola. Bugun shu ko‘nikmalarni imtihon essesiga olib o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida 9 ballik esseni gapma-gap tahlil qilasiz, dalilni chuqur rivojlantirasiz, so‘z va grammatikani aniq qilasiz va matningizni tizimli tekshirasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi safar ilmiy yozuvni ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun 9 ballik esseni gapma-gap ajratamiz, keyin uning ortidagi ko‘nikmalarni qayta quramiz.

scenes.title: To‘rt baholash mezoni
scenes.say: Four criteria carry equal weight. What distinguishes a band nine script is not ornament but control: an unmistakable position, invisible linking, and errors that look like slips.
scenes.say_native: IELTS Writing Task 2 essesi to‘rtta teng mezon bo‘yicha baholanadi: savolga javob, izchillik, lug‘at va grammatika. 9 ball murakkab so‘z degani emas. Pozitsiya to‘liq rivojlangan, bog‘lanish shunchalik tabiiyki, uni o‘quvchi sezmaydi, xato bo‘lsa ham faqat kamdan-kam “slip”, ya’ni tasodifiy toyilish bo‘ladi. Bitta zaif mezon butun ballni pastga tortadi.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt mezon teng og‘irlikka ega. 9 ballik ishni bezak emas, nazorat ajratib turadi: shubhasiz pozitsiya, sezilmaydigan bog‘lanish va tasodifiy toyilishga o‘xshash xatolar.

scenes.title: Tahlil qilinadigan savol
board: Some people think governments should spend money on public transport rather than on building new roads.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
scenes.say: The question asks to what extent you agree, so a neutral description of both sides will not do. Rather than tells you the money is limited.
scenes.say_native: Bugun bitta savol bo‘yicha yozilgan namunaviy esseni tahlil qilamiz. “To what extent” degani qanchalik qo‘shilishingizni aniq aytishingiz kerak. Ikki tomonni tasvirlab, “ikkisi ham muhim” deb qo‘ya qolish yetmaydi. “Rather than” iborasi ham muhim: pul cheklangan va ustuvorlikni tanlash kerak.
scenes.say_uz: Savol qanchalik qo‘shilishingizni so‘raydi, shuning uchun betaraf tasvir yetmaydi. Rather than pul cheklanganini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Namuna: kirish
board: Hook: Few issues shape… as directly as…
Thesis: I would argue that… since…
scenes.say: Few issues shape the daily lives of city dwellers as directly as the way they travel. While new roads can relieve congestion in the short term, I would argue that governments should prioritise public transport, since it serves more people, uses scarce urban land more efficiently and offers the only realistic route to lower emissions.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy essening kirishini tinglang. U ikki gapdan iborat. Birinchi gap mavzuni ochadi. Ikkinchi gap uch ishni birdaniga bajaradi: qarshi tomonga qisqa yon beradi, pozitsiyani aytadi va uchta sababni sanaydi. Tinglayotganda pozitsiya bildiruvchi fe’lni topishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar aholisining kundalik hayotiga qatnov usulichalik bevosita ta’sir qiladigan masala kam. Yangi yo‘llar qisqa muddatda tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkin bo‘lsa-da, menimcha, hukumatlar jamoat transportini ustuvor qo‘yishi kerak, chunki u ko‘proq odamga xizmat qiladi, tanqis shahar yerini samaraliroq ishlatadi va chiqindilarni kamaytirishning yagona real yo‘lidir.

scenes.title: Kirish tahlili
scenes.say: Notice what is missing: no copied question, no dictionary definition, no announcement. Every word is already doing argumentative work.
scenes.say_native: Tahlil qilamiz. Muallif savolni ko‘chirmagan: “spend money on” o‘rniga “prioritise”. “While” bilan boshlangan qism qarshi fikrni tan oladi. “I would argue” pozitsiyani aniq, lekin vazmin bildiradi. “Since” dan keyingi uchta sabab esa butun essening rejasi. Kirishda “In this essay I will discuss” kabi e’lon yo‘q, har bir so‘z allaqachon ishlayapti.
scenes.say_uz: Nima yo‘qligiga e’tibor bering: ko‘chirilgan savol, lug‘at ta’rifi, e’lon yo‘q. Har bir so‘z allaqachon dalil vazifasini bajaryapti.

scenes.title: Namuna: birinchi asosiy xatboshi
board: Topic sentence: The most compelling argument…
scenes.say: The most compelling argument for public transport is one of efficiency. A single bus lane can carry several times as many people per hour as a lane of private cars, which means that every pound invested reaches far more commuters. Widening roads, by contrast, tends to generate fresh traffic: as journeys become quicker, more people choose to drive, and within a few years the new lanes are as congested as the old ones.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi asosiy xatboshini tinglang. U bitta g‘oyaga bag‘ishlangan: samaradorlik. Muallif bir nechta sababni sanamaydi, bitta sababni oxirigacha olib boradi. Har bir gap oldingisiga qanday tayanishini kuzatib boring. “By contrast” iborasidan keyin nima o‘zgarishini kuzating.
scenes.say_uz: Jamoat transporti foydasiga eng kuchli dalil samaradorlikdir. Bitta avtobus yo‘lagi soatiga shaxsiy avtomobil yo‘lagidan bir necha baravar ko‘p odam tashiy oladi, demak, sarflangan har bir pul ancha ko‘p yo‘lovchiga yetadi. Yo‘llarni kengaytirish esa, aksincha, yangi tirbandlik tug‘diradi: safar tezlashgani sari ko‘proq odam mashinani tanlaydi va bir necha yildan keyin yangi yo‘laklar eskilari kabi tirband bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Birinchi xatboshi tahlili
board: which means that / as… / within a few years
scenes.say: Each sentence grows out of the one before it, so the paragraph needs very few linking words. That is what invisible cohesion means in practice.
scenes.say_native: Bu xatboshining kuchi zanjirida. Da’vo: samaradorlik. Mexanizm: bitta yo‘lak ko‘proq odam tashiydi. Oqibat: har bir pul ko‘proq odamga yetadi. Keyin teskari holat va uzoq muddatli natija. Har bir gap oldingisidan kelib chiqadi, shuning uchun “Moreover” kabi bog‘lovchilar deyarli kerak emas. Bog‘lanishni mantiqning o‘zi beradi.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gap oldingisidan o‘sib chiqadi, shuning uchun bog‘lovchi so‘zlar kam kerak. Sezilmaydigan bog‘lanish amalda shu.

scenes.title: Namuna: ikkinchi asosiy xatboshi
board: Yet this argues for…, not for…
scenes.say: Admittedly, roads cannot be abandoned altogether. Rural communities, freight and emergency services all depend on them, and in sparsely populated areas a frequent bus service would be prohibitively expensive. Yet this argues for maintaining the roads we already have, not for building new ones in cities, where the case for public transport is overwhelming.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi xatboshi boshqacha ish qiladi: qarshi tomonning eng kuchli dalilini tan oladi va uni muallif pozitsiyasiga xizmat qildiradi. Bu yon berish va raddiya. “Yet” so‘zidan keyingi gap butun xatboshining burilish nuqtasi, shunga alohida quloq soling.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri, yo‘llardan butunlay voz kechib bo‘lmaydi. Qishloq jamoalari, yuk tashish va favqulodda xizmatlar ularga bog‘liq, aholisi siyrak hududlarda esa tez-tez qatnovchi avtobus haddan tashqari qimmatga tushadi. Biroq bu mavjud yo‘llarni saqlashni oqlaydi, shaharlarda yangilarini qurishni emas, u yerda esa jamoat transporti foydasiga dalil juda kuchli.

scenes.title: Yon berish va raddiya tahlili
scenes.say: A weak writer ignores the opposing view or surrenders to it. A strong writer accepts what is true in it and shows precisely where its force ends.
scenes.say_native: Muallif “yo‘llar foydali” degan fikrni rad etmaydi, chunki bu rost. U faqat bu dalil nimani isbotlashini toraytiradi: yo‘llar kerak, lekin mavjudlarini saqlash uchun, yangi shahar yo‘llari uchun emas. Shunday qilib, raqib dalili muallif pozitsiyasini kuchaytiradi. 9 ballik esseda yon berish zaiflik emas, ishonchlilik belgisi.
scenes.say_uz: Zaif muallif qarshi fikrni e’tiborsiz qoldiradi yoki unga taslim bo‘ladi. Kuchli muallif undagi haqiqatni qabul qilib, uning kuchi qayerda tugashini aniq ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Namuna: xulosa
scenes.say: In conclusion, although road investment retains a place in rural areas, the bulk of public funding should go to public transport. Only then can cities become less congested, cleaner and fairer to those who cannot afford to drive.
scenes.say_native: Xulosani tinglang. Unda yangi dalil yo‘q, lekin kirish so‘zma-so‘z takrorlanmaydi ham: pozitsiya endi chegarasi bilan aniq. “Only then can cities” inversiyasi grammatik xilma-xillikni tabiiy ko‘rsatadi, oxirgi gap esa natija kimga foyda berishini aytadi. Butun esse taxminan ikki yuz yetmish so‘z: uzunlik emas, zichlik baholanadi.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, yo‘lga sarmoya qishloq hududlarida o‘z o‘rnini saqlasa-da, davlat mablag‘ining asosiy qismi jamoat transportiga yo‘naltirilishi kerak. Faqat shundagina shaharlar kamroq tirband, tozaroq va mashina sotib ololmaydiganlar uchun adolatliroq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek inshosi bilan farq
board: Position in paragraph 1, not at the end
scenes.say: In English academic writing, the reader expects the destination before the journey. Say where you stand first, then earn that position.
scenes.say_native: Maktab inshosini eslang. Ko‘pincha maqol yoki ko‘tarinki gap bilan boshlaymiz, ritorik savollar beramiz, fikrimizni esa oxirida ochamiz. Ingliz akademik essesida mantiq teskari: pozitsiya birinchi xatboshidayoq aytiladi, keyin isbotlanadi. Hissiyot o‘rniga ochiq sabab-oqibat talab qilinadi. Bu madaniy farq, uni ongli ravishda o‘zgartiring.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz akademik yozuvida o‘quvchi yo‘ldan oldin manzilni kutadi. Avval qayerda turganingizni ayting, keyin bu pozitsiyani isbotlang.

scenes.title: Gap vazifasini toping
board: A Admittedly, roads cannot be abandoned.
B I would argue that governments should prioritise…
C A single bus lane can carry several times as many…
D Only then can cities become cleaner.
scenes.say: Match each sentence to its function: thesis, mechanism, concession or final significance. A: Admittedly, roads cannot be abandoned. B: I would argue that governments should prioritise public transport. C: A single bus lane can carry several times as many people. D: Only then can cities become cleaner.
scenes.say_native: Namunadan to‘rtta gap ekranda. Har birining esse ichidagi vazifasini aniqlang: tezis, mexanizm, yon berish yoki yakuniy ahamiyat. Gap qaysi so‘z bilan boshlanishini va essening qaysi qismida turganini eslang: kirishdami, asosiy qismdami yoki xulosadami. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni vazifasiga moslang: tezis, mexanizm, yon berish yoki yakuniy ahamiyat. A: To‘g‘ri, yo‘llardan voz kechib bo‘lmaydi. B: Menimcha, hukumatlar jamoat transportini ustuvor qo‘yishi kerak. C: Bitta avtobus yo‘lagi bir necha baravar ko‘p odam tashiydi. D: Faqat shundagina shaharlar tozaroq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: A is the concession, B the thesis, C the mechanism and D the final significance.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. A yon berish: “Admittedly” qarshi tomonning to‘g‘ri fikrini tan oladi. B tezis: “I would argue” pozitsiyani ochadi. C mexanizm: samaradorlik qanday ishlashini tushuntiradi. D yakuniy ahamiyat: inversiya bilan natija kimga foyda berishini aytadi. O‘z essengizni ham shunday belgilay olsangiz, imtihonchidek fikrlayapsiz.
scenes.say_uz: A yon berish, B tezis, C mexanizm, D yakuniy ahamiyat.

scenes.title: Dalil zanjiri
scenes.say: Most candidates state a reason and jump to an example. The band nine writer pauses to explain how the reason actually works. That middle step makes an argument feel inevitable.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: dalilni rivojlantirish. Ko‘pchilik PEEL formulasini biladi, lekin C2 darajasida “explain” qismi ko‘pincha bitta umumiy gap bo‘lib qoladi. Shuning uchun besh bo‘g‘inli zanjirni tavsiya qilaman: da’vo, sabab, mexanizm, ya’ni sabab qanday ishlashi, aniq misol va oqibat. Aynan mexanizm bo‘g‘ini 7 balldan 9 ballni ajratadi.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p nomzodlar sababni aytib, darhol misolga sakraydi. 9 ballik muallif sabab qanday ishlashini tushuntiradi. Aynan shu o‘rta qadam dalilni muqarrar qiladi.

scenes.title: Fikrni uzaytirish vositalari
board: which in turn… (bu esa o‘z navbatida)

examples.t: Cheaper fares increase ridership, which in turn justifies more frequent services.
examples.uz: Arzonroq yo‘l haqi yo‘lovchilarni ko‘paytiradi, bu esa o‘z navbatida qatnovni ko‘paytirishni oqlaydi.

examples.t: The knock-on effect is that local businesses lose customers.
examples.uz: Zanjirli ta’siri shundaki, mahalliy bizneslar mijozlarini yo‘qotadi.

scenes.say: These phrases force you to take the next logical step, and that step is usually where the real insight lies.
scenes.say_native: Fikrni bir qadam oldinga surish uchun tabiiy iboralar bor. “Which in turn” birinchi oqibatdan ikkinchisini chiqaradi. “The knock-on effect is that” zanjirli ta’sirni bildiradi. “This matters because” nega muhimligini aytadi. Bular bezak emas: har biri yangi mantiqiy qadamni boshlaydi, ularsiz fikr birinchi oqibatda to‘xtab qoladi.
scenes.say_uz: Bu iboralar sizni keyingi mantiqiy qadamga majbur qiladi, haqiqiy chuqur fikr esa odatda aynan shu qadamda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Yon berish va chegaralash
board: While it is true that…, this overlooks…
at least in densely populated cities

examples.t: While it is true that cars offer flexibility, this overlooks their cost to everyone else.
examples.uz: Mashinalar erkinlik berishi rost bo‘lsa-da, bu ularning boshqalar uchun narxini e’tiborsiz qoldiradi.

scenes.say: Keep the concession short and the rebuttal long. And qualify your claim: an absolute statement invites a single counterexample to destroy it.
scenes.say_native: Yon berishning eng nozik qolipi: “While it is true that…, this overlooks…”. Siz raqib fikrini rad etmaysiz, u nimanidir hisobga olmaganini ko‘rsatasiz. Qoida: yon berish qisqa, raddiya uzunroq. Pozitsiyani “at least in densely populated cities” kabi qo‘shimcha bilan chegaralash ham uni zaiflashtirmaydi, himoya qilinadigan qiladi. “Always” va “never” esa bitta qarshi misol bilan yiqiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Yon berishni qisqa, raddiyani uzun qiling. Da’voingizni chegaralang: mutlaq gap uni yiqitish uchun bitta qarshi misolni chaqiradi.

scenes.title: O‘zbek dalil uslubi bilan farq
scenes.say: An English academic reader is sceptical by default. As everyone knows does not persuade them; it makes them look for the evidence you have not provided.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek nutqida dalil ko‘pincha obro‘ yoki umumiy qadriyatga tayanadi: “ota-bobolarimiz aytganidek”, “hammaga ma’lumki”. Madaniyatimizda umumiy donolik kuchli, shuning uchun bu ishontiradi. Ingliz akademik o‘quvchisi esa “Nega?” deb so‘raydi va har bir qadamni ko‘rmoqchi. Maqol o‘rniga mexanizmni ochiq yozing, to‘qima raqam o‘rniga halol, tekshiriladigan misol bering.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz akademik o‘quvchisi tabiatan shubhalanuvchi. “Hammaga ma’lumki” uni ishontirmaydi, siz keltirmagan dalilni qidirishga undaydi.

scenes.title: Sanash, rivojlantirmaslik
board: ✗ Firstly, cost. Secondly, pollution. Thirdly, time.
scenes.say: Three undeveloped reasons are weaker than one developed reason. A list shows you have ideas; only development shows you can think with them.
scenes.say_native: Juda ko‘p uchraydigan xato: bitta xatboshida uchta sababni bir gapdan sanash. “Firstly, it is cheaper. Secondly, it reduces pollution. Thirdly, it saves time.” Bu ro‘yxat, dalil emas. Imtihonchi buni rivojlanmagan fikr deb baholaydi va Task Response bahosi tushadi. Kamroq fikr tanlang va har birini zanjir bilan oxirigacha olib boring.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta rivojlanmagan sabab bitta rivojlangan sababdan zaif. Ro‘yxat g‘oyangiz borligini, rivojlantirish esa ular bilan fikrlay olishingizni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Zanjirni tiklang
board: A which in turn reduces the number of cars on the road.
B Free travel for students would raise ridership,
C Fewer cars mean cleaner air near schools.
D Students are a large and price-sensitive group.
scenes.say: Put the four parts in a logical order. A: which in turn reduces the number of cars on the road. B: Free travel for students would raise ridership. C: Fewer cars mean cleaner air near schools. D: Students are a large and price-sensitive group.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta bo‘lak aralashtirilgan. Ularni da’vo, sabab, mexanizm va oqibat tartibida joylashtiring. Avval umumiy da’voni toping, keyin har bir bo‘lak oldingisidan qanday kelib chiqishini o‘ylang. Vergul va “which in turn” iborasi sizga ishora beradi. Tartibni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt qismni mantiqiy tartibga keltiring. A: bu esa o‘z navbatida yo‘ldagi mashinalarni kamaytiradi. B: Talabalar uchun bepul yo‘l yo‘lovchilarni ko‘paytiradi. C: Kamroq mashina maktablar yonida tozaroq havo demak. D: Talabalar katta va narxga sezgir guruh.

scenes.title: Javob
scenes.say: Free travel for students would raise ridership, which in turn reduces the number of cars on the road. Students are a large, price-sensitive group, and fewer cars mean cleaner air near schools.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: B, D, A, C. Avval da’vo: bepul yo‘l yo‘lovchilarni ko‘paytiradi. Keyin sabab: talabalar katta va narxga sezgir guruh. Keyin mexanizm: “which in turn” bilan mashinalar kamayadi. Oxirida oqibat: maktablar yonida havo tozaroq. Yozuvda A bo‘lagi B ga vergul bilan ulanadi, D esa alohida gap bo‘lib keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Talabalar uchun bepul yo‘l yo‘lovchilarni ko‘paytiradi, bu esa yo‘ldagi mashinalarni kamaytiradi. Talabalar katta va narxga sezgir guruh, kamroq mashina esa maktablar yonida tozaroq havo demak.

scenes.title: Aniq lug‘at
board: many people → a substantial proportion of

examples.t: The city faces an acute shortage of affordable housing.
examples.uz: Shahar arzon uy-joyning keskin tanqisligiga duch kelmoqda.

scenes.say: Acute suggests something severe and immediate; chronic suggests something that has lasted for years. Both are better than big, but they are not interchangeable.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: aniq lug‘at va xatosiz grammatika. 9 ballik lug‘at murakkab emas, aniq. “Big problem” o‘rniga muammoning turini ayting: “an acute shortage”, “a chronic lack”. “Bad effect” o‘rniga “a detrimental impact on”. Har bir umumiy so‘z ustida to‘xtab, o‘zingizdan so‘rang: aniqroq ayta olamanmi?
scenes.say_uz: Acute jiddiy va dolzarb narsani, chronic esa yillar davom etgan narsani bildiradi. Ikkalasi ham big dan yaxshi, lekin ularni almashtirib bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Akademik kollokatsiyalar
board: pose a threat to / exacerbate congestion
mitigate the impact of / allocate funds to
a compelling argument / a viable alternative

examples.t: Building more roads may exacerbate congestion rather than mitigate it.
examples.uz: Ko‘proq yo‘l qurish tirbandlikni yumshatish o‘rniga kuchaytirishi mumkin.

scenes.say: Native writers think in collocations, not single words. Learn pose a threat and allocate funds as complete units.
scenes.say_native: Lug‘at bahosi alohida so‘zlar emas, birikmalar orqali o‘lchanadi. Inglizlar “make a threat” emas, “pose a threat” deydi. “Exacerbate” va “mitigate” juft fe’llar: biri yomonlashtiradi, biri yumshatadi. “Allocate funds to” pul haqida juda tabiiy. Bu birikmalarni butun blok sifatida yodlang, shunda ular yozuvingizda o‘z-o‘zidan paydo bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Ona tilida yozuvchilar alohida so‘z bilan emas, birikmalar bilan fikrlaydi. Pose a threat va allocate funds ni butun blok sifatida o‘rganing.

scenes.title: Klishe va noto‘g‘ri birikma
board: ✗ a double-edged sword / last but not least
scenes.say: A cliché tells the examiner you have memorised a phrase; a wrong collocation tells them you have translated one.
scenes.say_native: Ikki turdagi xato lug‘at bahosini pasaytiradi. Birinchisi, siyqasi chiqqan iboralar: “a double-edged sword”, “last but not least”. Ular to‘g‘ri, lekin yodlangan andoza bo‘lib ko‘rinadi. Ikkinchisi, rus yoki o‘zbek tilidan ko‘chirilgan birikmalar: “do a crime” o‘rniga “commit a crime”, “make research” o‘rniga “conduct research” yoki “carry out research”.
scenes.say_uz: Klishe imtihonchiga iborani yodlaganingizni, noto‘g‘ri birikma esa uni tarjima qilganingizni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Maqsadli grammatik xilma-xillik
board: Participle clause: Faced with rising costs, …

examples.t: Faced with rising costs, many councils have cut bus routes.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar oshishiga duch kelib, ko‘p mahalliy kengashlar avtobus yo‘nalishlarini qisqartirdi.

examples.t: What cities need is not more lanes but fewer cars.
examples.uz: Shaharlarga ko‘proq yo‘lak emas, kamroq mashina kerak.

scenes.say: An essay full of inversions sounds like a grammar exercise; one well-placed inversion sounds like a writer in control.
scenes.say_native: Grammatik xilma-xillik ko‘rgazma emas. Inversiya urg‘u beradi, sifatdoshli bo‘lak ikki fikrni ixcham bog‘laydi, “What… is” tuzilmasi esa asosiy g‘oyani gap oxiriga, eng kuchli o‘ringa olib chiqadi. Har birini faqat fikringizga xizmat qilganda ishlating. Bitta essega uch-to‘rtta shunday gap yetarli.
scenes.say_uz: Inversiyaga to‘la esse grammatika mashqiga o‘xshaydi, o‘z o‘rnidagi bitta inversiya esa vaziyatni nazorat qilayotgan muallifni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Artikllar: umumiy fikr
board: Ø governments / the government of one country

examples.t: Public transport is cheaper than the car for most commuters.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik qatnovchilar uchun jamoat transporti avtomobildan arzonroq.

scenes.say: The choice depends on whether you mean something general or something specific, a distinction Uzbek leaves to context.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun eng ko‘p toyilish shu yerda. Umumiy fikrda sanalmaydigan ot artiklsiz keladi: “public transport is”, “pollution affects”. Ko‘plikdagi umumiy ot ham: “governments should”. Rasmiy uslubda butun turni “the” bilan aytish mumkin: “the car has changed cities”. Muayyan davlat haqida esa “the government”.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlov umumiy yoki muayyan narsa nazarda tutilganiga bog‘liq, o‘zbek tili esa bu farqni kontekstga qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Artikl va moslik xatolari
board: ✗ The number of cars are rising.
✓ The number of cars is rising. / A number of cities have…
scenes.say: The number of is singular because you mean the number itself. A number of means several, so the verb is plural.
scenes.say_native: Ikki klassik xato. Birinchisi, umumiy sanalmaydigan otga “the” qo‘shish: to‘g‘risi “Public transport is essential”. Ikkinchisi, moslik. “The number of cars” birlik, chunki ega “number”: “is rising”. “A number of cities” esa “bir qancha shahar” degani va ko‘plikda: “have introduced”. Bu juftlikni bir marta yaxshilab o‘rganib oling.
scenes.say_uz: The number of birlikda, chunki sonning o‘zi nazarda tutilgan. A number of “bir nechta” degani, shuning uchun fe’l ko‘plikda.

scenes.title: Tinish belgisi va bog‘lovchi
board: ✗ Roads are useful, however they are costly.
✓ Roads are useful; however, they are costly.
✗ despite of / on the other side  ✓ despite / on the other hand
scenes.say: However is an adverb, so it cannot join two sentences with a comma. Use a semicolon or a full stop, or switch to but.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tez-tez uchraydigan toyilish. Birinchisi, ikki to‘liq gapni vergul bilan ulash: “however” bog‘lovchi emas, ravish, undan oldin nuqta yoki nuqtali vergul kerak. Ikkinchisi, “despite of”: to‘g‘risi “despite” yoki “in spite of”. Uchinchisi, “on the other side” o‘rniga “on the other hand”. Kichik xatolar, lekin beshtasi birga 9 ballni olib ketadi.
scenes.say_uz: However ravish, shuning uchun ikki gapni vergul bilan ulay olmaydi. Nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta qo‘ying, yoki but ga o‘ting.

scenes.title: Tuzating va kuchaytiring
board: 1 The pollution is a big problem in cities.
2 The number of buses are not enough.
3 Despite of the cost, it is good idea.
4 Cars have bad effect on health.
scenes.say: Correct and upgrade each sentence. One: The pollution is a big problem in cities. Two: The number of buses are not enough. Three: Despite of the cost, it is good idea. Four: Cars have bad effect on health.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap ekranda. Har birida kamida bitta grammatik xato bor va har birini aniqroq lug‘at bilan kuchaytirish mumkin. Avval xatoni toping, keyin umumiy so‘zni aniq birikmaga almashtiring. Artikllar, moslik va “despite” ga alohida e’tibor bering. Har bir gapni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni tuzating va kuchaytiring. Bir: Ifloslanish shaharlarda katta muammo. Ikki: Avtobuslar soni yetarli emas. Uch: Narxiga qaramay, bu yaxshi g‘oya. To‘rt: Mashinalar sog‘liqqa yomon ta’sir qiladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Pollution poses a serious threat to urban health.
2 The number of buses is insufficient.
3 Despite the cost, it is a sound idea.
4 Cars have a detrimental impact on health.
scenes.say: Pollution poses a serious threat to urban health. The number of buses is insufficient. Despite the cost, it is a sound idea. Cars have a detrimental impact on health.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchida umumiy “pollution” artiklsiz, “big problem” o‘rniga “poses a serious threat”. Ikkinchida ega “number”, shuning uchun “is”, “not enough” o‘rniga “insufficient”. Uchinchida “despite” dan keyin “of” kerak emas, “a” artikli tushib qolgan, “good” o‘rniga “sound”. To‘rtinchida “a detrimental impact on”. Boshqa aniq variantlar ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say_uz: Ifloslanish shahar aholisi sog‘lig‘iga jiddiy xavf soladi. Avtobuslar soni yetarli emas. Narxiga qaramay, bu asosli g‘oya. Mashinalar sog‘liqqa zararli ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Vaqt va tekshiruv bosqichlari
scenes.say: When you read for everything, you notice nothing, because your brain reads what you meant rather than what you wrote. One error type per pass breaks that illusion.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: yakuniy tekshiruv. Task 2 ga taxminan qirq daqiqa: besh daqiqa reja, o‘ttiz yozish, besh tekshirish. Asosiy sir: matnni bir marta umumiy o‘qimang. Har o‘qishda bitta xato turini qidiring: artikllar, fe’l qo‘shimchalari, imlo, tinish belgilari. O‘zingizning takrorlanuvchi xatolaringizni ham ro‘yxatga qo‘shing. Imloda bitta variantga sodiq qoling: “programme” yoki “program”.
scenes.say_uz: Hamma narsani qidirsangiz, hech narsani sezmaysiz, chunki miya yozganingizni emas, nazarda tutganingizni o‘qiydi. Har safar bitta xato turi bu illyuziyani buzadi.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz shakllar va yozuv

examples.t: The city could have invested earlier.
examples.uz: Shahar ertaroq sarmoya kiritishi mumkin edi.

scenes.say: In connected speech, could have sounds like could of, because have is reduced to a weak form. Native speakers make this spelling mistake too.
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz bilan bog‘liq qiziq nuqta. Tez nutqda “of”, “to”, “a”, “have” kabi so‘zlar kuchsiz shaklda, shva tovushi bilan aytiladi: “could have” deyarli “could of” kabi eshitiladi. Shuning uchun yozganda bu kichik so‘zlar tushib qoladi yoki noto‘g‘ri yoziladi. Tekshirishda matnni ichingizda sekin, har bir so‘zni to‘liq shaklda o‘qing.
scenes.say_uz: Uzviy nutqda could have xuddi could of kabi eshitiladi, chunki have kuchsiz shaklga qisqaradi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham bu xatoni qiladi.

scenes.title: Kuchsiz shakl tufayli xatolar
board: ✗ should of / could of  ✓ should have / could have
✗ alot  ✓ a lot (or: a great deal)
scenes.say: Should of is never correct in writing. Its shows possession, as in the city and its residents; it’s always means it is or it has.
scenes.say_native: O‘xshash talaffuz bir nechta imlo xatosiga sabab bo‘ladi. “Should of” har doim xato, to‘g‘risi “should have”. “Alot” emas, ikki so‘z: “a lot”, lekin esseda “a great deal” yaxshiroq. “Its” egalik, “it’s” esa “it is” yoki “it has”. “To” va “too” ham shunday: “too late”. Bular imlo bosqichida tutiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Should of yozuvda hech qachon to‘g‘ri emas. Its egalikni bildiradi, it’s esa har doim it is yoki it has.

scenes.title: Xatboshini tekshiring
board: Governments should of invested in the public transport
decades ago, however they chose roads. The number
of drivers have doubled and its now to late to
scenes.say: Find six errors. Governments should of invested in the public transport decades ago, however they chose roads. The number of drivers have doubled and its now to late to simply build more lanes.
scenes.say_native: Endi siz tekshiruvchisiz. Ekrandagi qisqa xatboshida oltita xato bor. To‘rt bosqichni qo‘llang: artikllar, fe’l shakllari, imlo va tinish belgilari. Har bir xatoni topib, to‘g‘ri variantini ayting. Shoshilmang, har bir so‘zni alohida, ichingizda to‘liq shaklda o‘qing.
scenes.say_uz: Oltita xatoni toping. Hukumatlar o‘nlab yillar oldin jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritishi kerak edi, biroq ular yo‘llarni tanladi. Haydovchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi va endi shunchaki ko‘proq yo‘lak qurishga juda kech.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Governments should have invested in public transport decades ago. However, they chose roads. The number of drivers has doubled, and it’s now too late to simply build more lanes.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: “should have”. Ikki: umumiy “public transport” artiklsiz. Uch: “however” oldidan nuqta, keyin vergul. To‘rt: “The number of drivers has doubled”, ega birlikda. Besh: “its” o‘rniga “it’s”. Olti: “to late” emas, “too late”. Oltitasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, tekshiruv tizimingiz ishlayapti.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumatlar o‘nlab yillar oldin jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritishi kerak edi. Biroq ular yo‘llarni tanladi. Haydovchilar soni ikki baravar oshdi va endi shunchaki yo‘lak qurishga juda kech.

scenes.title: Dialog: o‘qituvchi bilan
board: Tutor: … lists three reasons and develops none.
Student: So should I cut one?
scenes.say: Tutor: I’ve read your essay, Aziz. The ideas are strong, but your second paragraph lists three reasons and develops none of them. Aziz: So should I cut one? Tutor: Cut two, actually. Keep the strongest and show me the consequence. Aziz: And the language? Tutor: Mostly accurate. A few missing articles, and you wrote could of instead of could have. Aziz: That’s embarrassing. Tutor: It’s a slip. Just add it to your checklist.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Talaba Aziz o‘qituvchisidan essesi haqida fikr oladi. Uch narsaga quloq soling: ikkinchi xatboshidagi muammo nima, o‘qituvchi nechta sababni qoldirishni aytadi va qaysi ikki til xatosi tilga olinadi. Dialog tabiiy tezlikda, kalit so‘zlarga e’tibor qarating.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Essengizni o‘qidim, Aziz. G‘oyalar kuchli, lekin ikkinchi xatboshida uchta sababni sanab, birortasini rivojlantirmagansiz. Aziz: Demak, bittasini olib tashlaymi? O‘qituvchi: Aslida ikkitasini. Eng kuchlisini qoldirib, oqibatini ko‘rsating. Aziz: Til-chi? O‘qituvchi: Asosan to‘g‘ri. Bir nechta artikl tushib qolgan va could have o‘rniga could of yozibsiz. Aziz: Uyat bo‘ldi. O‘qituvchi: Bu tasodifiy xato. Ro‘yxatingizga qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1 What is wrong with paragraph two?
2 How many reasons should Aziz keep?
3 Which two language problems are mentioned?
scenes.say: One: what is wrong with paragraph two? Two: how many reasons should Aziz keep? Three: which two language problems are mentioned?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: ikkinchi xatboshining muammosi nima? Ikkinchi: Aziz nechta sababni qoldirishi kerak? Uchinchi: qaysi ikki til muammosi aytildi? Qo‘shimcha savol: “Cut two, actually” gapidagi “actually” so‘zi Azizning taxmini haqida nimani bildiradi?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ikkinchi xatboshida nima noto‘g‘ri? Ikki: Aziz nechta sababni qoldirishi kerak? Uch: qaysi ikki til muammosi aytiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3 Missing articles; could of → could have
scenes.say: The paragraph lists three reasons without developing any. Aziz should keep only the strongest. The problems are missing articles and could of.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uchta sabab sanalgan, birortasi rivojlantirilmagan. Ikkinchi: faqat bitta, eng kuchlisi qoladi. “Actually” bu yerda Azizning taxminini to‘g‘rilaydi: u bitta deb o‘ylagan, aslida ikkitasini olib tashlash kerak. Uchinchi: tushib qolgan artikllar va “could of”. Bugungi darsning deyarli hammasi shu dialogda!
scenes.say_uz: Xatboshida uchta sabab rivojlantirilmay sanalgan. Aziz faqat eng kuchlisini qoldirishi kerak. Muammolar: tushib qolgan artikllar va could of.

scenes.title: Dialog: ikki talaba
scenes.say: Malika: How long do you spend planning? Jasur: About five minutes, but I never leave time to check. Malika: That’s where you lose marks. I write for thirty minutes, then do three quick passes: articles, verb endings, spelling. Jasur: Three passes in five minutes? Malika: Each one takes barely a minute or two, because I’m only looking for one thing. Jasur: Clever. And the word count? Malika: I count lines, not words. I know I write about ten words a line.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Malika va Jasur imtihonda vaqtni qanday taqsimlashini muhokama qiladi. Quloq soling: Jasur nimani qilmaydi, Malika qaysi uch bosqichda tekshiradi va so‘zlar sonini qanday hisoblaydi. Malikaning usuli bugun o‘rgangan strategiyamizga juda yaqin.
scenes.say_uz: Malika: Rejaga qancha vaqt ketkazasan? Jasur: Besh daqiqacha, lekin tekshirishga hech vaqt qoldirmayman. Malika: Ballni aynan shu yerda yo‘qotasan. Men o‘ttiz daqiqa yozaman, keyin uch marta tez o‘tib chiqaman: artikllar, fe’l qo‘shimchalari, imlo. Jasur: Besh daqiqada uch marta? Malika: Har biri bir-ikki daqiqa oladi, chunki faqat bitta narsani qidiraman. Jasur: Zo‘r. So‘zlar soni-chi? Malika: So‘zlarni emas, qatorlarni sanayman. Bir qatorga o‘n so‘zcha yozishimni bilaman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3 How does she estimate the word count?
scenes.say: One: what does Jasur never do? Two: what are Malika’s three passes? Three: how does she estimate her word count?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: Jasur nimani hech qachon qilmaydi? Ikkinchi: Malikaning uch tekshiruv bosqichi qaysilar? Uchinchi: u so‘zlar sonini qanday taxmin qiladi? O‘zingizdan yana so‘rang: Malika nega har bir o‘tishga atigi bir-ikki daqiqa sarflay oladi?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Jasur nimani hech qachon qilmaydi? Ikki: Malikaning uch bosqichi qaysilar? Uch: u so‘zlar sonini qanday taxmin qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Jasur never leaves time to check. Malika checks articles, verb endings and spelling separately, and counts lines to estimate her words.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Jasur tekshirishga vaqt qoldirmaydi. Ikkinchi: Malika artikllar, fe’l qo‘shimchalari va imlo bo‘yicha alohida o‘tadi. Uchinchi: u qatorlarni sanaydi, chunki bir qatorga o‘n so‘z atrofida yozishini biladi. Har bir o‘tish tez, chunki bir vaqtda faqat bitta narsa qidiriladi. Bu aynan biz o‘rgangan usul.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur tekshirishga vaqt qoldirmaydi. Malika artikl, fe’l qo‘shimchasi va imloni alohida tekshiradi, so‘zlarni qatorlar orqali taxmin qiladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq
board: Prompt: City centres should be closed to private cars.
Chain: claim → reason → mechanism → example → implication
scenes.say: Your turn. Some people think city centres should be closed to private cars. Write a one-sentence thesis and one developed body paragraph, then proofread it in four passes.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz yozasiz. Mavzu: shahar markazlari shaxsiy mashinalar uchun yopilishi kerakmi? Pauza qilib, bir gaplik tezis va bitta asosiy xatboshi yozing. Unda besh bo‘g‘inli zanjir, bitta aniq kollokatsiya va bitta maqsadli murakkab tuzilma bo‘lsin. Keyin to‘rt bosqichli tekshiruvni qo‘llang.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Ba’zilar shahar markazlarini shaxsiy mashinalarga yopish kerak deb hisoblaydi. Bir gaplik tezis va bitta rivojlangan xatboshi yozing, keyin to‘rt bosqichda tekshiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
scenes.say: Thesis: I largely agree, provided that deliveries and disabled drivers are exempt. Body: Car-free centres make walking and cycling safer, which in turn draws more shoppers to local businesses. Several European cities have pedestrianised their historic cores, and the result has been quieter, more liveable streets.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobni tinglang va o‘zingiznikini solishtiring. Tezis qisman roziligini chegarasi bilan aytadi. Xatboshida da’vo, mexanizm, misol va oqibat bor. Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy. Muhimi: zanjir to‘liqmi, kollokatsiya aniqmi va tekshiruvdan keyin artikl yoki qo‘shimcha xatosi qolmadimi.
scenes.say_uz: Tezis: Yuk yetkazish va nogironligi bor haydovchilar istisno qilinsa, asosan qo‘shilaman. Asosiy qism: Mashinasiz markazlar piyoda va velosipedda yurishni xavfsizroq qiladi, bu esa o‘z navbatida mahalliy bizneslarga ko‘proq xaridor jalb qiladi. Bir qancha Yevropa shaharlari tarixiy markazlarini piyodalar zonasiga aylantirgan va ko‘chalar tinchroq, yashashga qulayroq bo‘lgan.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: One idea per paragraph, fully developed
scenes.say: State your position early, develop one idea at a time, choose the exact word and proofread one error type at a time.
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. 9 ballik esse bezak emas, nazorat. Pozitsiya birinchi xatboshida aniq. Har bir xatbosh bitta g‘oyani da’vo, sabab, mexanizm, misol va oqibat orqali rivojlantiradi. Yon berish qisqa, raddiya uzun. Lug‘at aniq birikmalardan iborat, murakkab grammatika vazifa bajaradi. Oxirida matn har safar bitta xato turi uchun tekshiriladi.
scenes.say_uz: Pozitsiyani erta ayting, bir vaqtda bitta g‘oyani rivojlantiring, aniq so‘zni tanlang va har safar bitta xato turini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Prompt: universities — jobs or academic knowledge?
Score each criterion and justify it
scenes.say: Your homework is a three-hundred-word essay with an honest self-score on all four criteria. Next time we learn to catch tone and intention in fast speech.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: universitetlar talabalarni ishga tayyorlashi kerakmi yoki akademik bilimga e’tibor qaratishi kerakmi, shu mavzuda uch yuz so‘zlik esse yozing va to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizga ball qo‘ying. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: aniq pozitsiya, har xatboshida to‘liq zanjir, bitta yon berish va raddiya, tekshiruvdan keyin artikl va imlo xatosi qolmasin. Keyingi darsda tezkor nutqdagi ohang va niyatni ilg‘ashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: uch yuz so‘zlik esse va to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha halol o‘z-o‘zini baholash. Keyingi safar tezkor nutqdagi ohang va niyatni ilg‘ashni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Quyidagi mavzuda 300 so‘zlik esse yozing: “Some people think universities should focus on preparing students for jobs rather than on academic knowledge. To what extent do you agree?” Keyin to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizga ball qo‘ying. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kirishda aniq pozitsiya, har bir asosiy xatboshida bitta da’vo to‘liq zanjir bilan rivojlangan, kamida bitta yon berish va raddiya, to‘rt bosqichli tekshiruvdan keyin artikl, fe’l qo‘shimchasi va imlo xatosi qolmagan bo‘lsin; har bir mezonga qo‘ygan balingizni bir gap bilan asoslang.

quiz.q: In a ‘To what extent’ essay, what must the introduction contain?
options: A clear position on the question
A definition of every key term
A sentence saying both sides are important
A famous proverb
quiz.why_uz: To what extent savoli aniq pozitsiyani talab qiladi; ta’rif yoki maqol bunga javob emas.

quiz.q: Which step most often separates band 7 from band 9 argument development?
options: Adding more reasons
Explaining the mechanism behind a reason
Using more linking words
Writing a longer conclusion
quiz.why_uz: Sababning qanday ishlashini, ya’ni mexanizmni ko‘rsatish fikrni chuqur qiladi.

options: The number of cars are rising.
The number of cars is rising.
A number of cities has introduced fees.
The numbers of car is rising.
quiz.why_uz: The number of birlikda, shuning uchun is.

options: Roads are useful, however they are costly.
Roads are useful however, they are costly.
Roads are useful; however, they are costly.
Roads are useful, however, they are costly.
quiz.why_uz: However ravish; ikki gap orasida nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta kerak.

options: make a threat to
do a crime
pose a threat to
make research
quiz.why_uz: Inglizchada pose a threat; commit a crime va conduct research ham to‘g‘ri birikmalar.

quiz.q: What is the best way to proofread in the last five minutes?
options: Read once for everything
Read once for each error type
Count every word
Rewrite the introduction
quiz.why_uz: Har o‘qishda bitta xato turini qidirish ko‘zga ko‘proq xatoni ko‘rsatadi.

options: Because have is reduced to a weak form /əv/ in speech
Because of is a modal verb
Because it is American spelling
Because could needs a preposition
quiz.why_uz: Tez nutqda have kuchsiz shaklda /əv/ eshitiladi, shuning uchun of bilan adashtiriladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct as a general statement?
options: The public transport is essential.
Public transport is essential.
A public transport is essential.
Public transports are essential.
quiz.why_uz: Umumiy ma’nodagi sanalmaydigan ot artiklsiz va birlikda keladi.

options: the concession is long and the rebuttal short
the writer changes position
the concession is short and the rebuttal longer
there is no rebuttal
quiz.why_uz: Yon berish qisqa, raddiya uzunroq bo‘lsa, o‘quvchi muallif pozitsiyasini eslab qoladi.

quiz.q: Which opening sentence is most effective?
options: Nowadays, this is a hotly debated topic.
In this essay I will discuss both views.
Few issues shape city life as directly as transport.
Transport is a very important thing.
quiz.why_uz: Faqat shu gap aynan shu mavzuga tegishli va yodlangan andoza emas.
